description: Astro 5.x static site starter — islands architecture, zero-JS by default, Vite-powered dev server, MDX-ready content.

buildHints.whenToUse: Content-focused static sites (marketing, docs, blogs) where you want islands of interactivity without shipping a full SPA runtime.
firstSteps: Install deps with `npm install`. Astro works with pnpm/yarn too but the lockfile here is npm by default.
Run `npm run dev` — Astro's Vite dev server binds to http://localhost:4321 with HMR.
Add pages by dropping `.astro` / `.md` / `.mdx` files into `src/pages/` — every file becomes a route (file-based routing).
Shared layout lives in `src/layouts/Base.astro`. Wrap each page with `<Base title="...">...</Base>`.
Build production output with `npm run build` — emits fully static HTML/CSS/JS into `./dist`. Preview locally with `npm run preview`.
gotchas: Frontmatter in `.astro` files runs at BUILD time on the server — you cannot reference browser globals (`window`, `document`) there. Put client code inside `<script>` tags or `client:*` directives.
To add a React/Vue/Svelte island you must install `@astrojs/<framework>` AND add it to `astro.config.mjs`'s `integrations` array. Just importing a `.jsx` file silently fails.
Content Collections (v5) replace loose `src/content/*.md` conventions — define a schema in `src/content.config.ts` or file-based content will not be typed.
`import.meta.env.PUBLIC_*` is the only prefix exposed to client bundles. Non-prefixed env vars are build-time server-only.
architectureNotes: Astro ships ZERO JS by default. Adding interactivity is opt-in per component via `client:load`, `client:idle`, `client:visible`, or `client:only`.
Output mode in `astro.config.mjs` defaults to `static`. Switch to `server` / `hybrid` only if the product actually needs SSR — this family is static-only.

placeholders.description: Default landing page with placeholder hero + feature grid. Replace ALL visible copy with the product's real content before shipping — treat it as boilerplate, not a template.
Shared HTML shell: <head>, meta tags, global CSS import, <slot /> for page body. Edit meta/OG tags before production.
